text: I’ve seen it myself ... many times.” (I had never seen it once, indeed I had never been in Volkovo, and had only heard stories of it.) “Do you mean to say, you don’t mind how you die?” “But why should I die?” she answered, as though defending herself. “Why, some day you will die, and you will die just the same as that dead woman. She was ... a girl like you. She died of consumption.” “A wench would have died in hospital ...” (She knows all about it already: she said “wench,” not “girl.”) “She was in debt to her madam,” I retorted, more and more provoked by the discussion; “and went on earning money for her up to the end, though she was in consumption.
